mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scm_supplier_evaluation (evaluation_id, tenant_id, supplier_id, quality_score, delivery_score, price_score, service_score, overall_score, comment, evaluated_at) VALUES (#{evaluationId}, #{tenantId}, #{supplierId}, #{qualityScore}, #{deliveryScore}, #{priceScore}, #{serviceScore}, #{overallScore}, #{comment}, #{evaluatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT evaluation_id, tenant_id, supplier_id, quality_score, delivery_score, price_score, service_score, overall_score, comment, evaluated_at FROM scm_supplier_evaluation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND supplier_id = #{supplierId} ORDER BY evaluated_at DESC

SELECT evaluation_id, tenant_id, supplier_id, quality_score, delivery_score, price_score, service_score, overall_score, comment, evaluated_at FROM scm_supplier_evaluation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND supplier_id = #{supplierId} ORDER BY evaluated_at DESC LIMIT 1
